task.title: Grant temporary administrator access
task.shortdesc: Standard operating procedure for the IT service desk. Use it when an engineer needs administrator rights in Acme Console for a fixed time. Fictional sample.

ul.li: The request names the engineer, the workspace, the reason, and the end date.
The engineer’s manager has approved the request in the ticket.
Access lasts eight hours at most. For a longer time, send the request to the IAM team.

step.cmd: In Acme Console, open Access > Temporary roles.
Select Grant, and then choose the engineer and the workspace.
Set the end time to the one in the request.
Paste the ticket number in Reason, and then select Save.
Add a comment to the ticket with the end time, and set the ticket to Waiting for expiry.

result.p: The engineer appears under Temporary roles with the end time you set. When that time passes, the role ends on its own and the ticket closes.

postreq.p: The change log in Acme Console keeps who granted the role, to whom, and why. Auditors read it each quarter.
